decision_rules.green: directional_stouffer_z >= 2.0, sign_hit_rate >= 0.75, no CP null danger, and delta_Re_C9 is negative if fit results are supplied; no absorptive, LFU-fit, or flatness danger
decision_rules.amber: directional_stouffer_z >= 1.0 or sign_hit_rate >= 0.60, with no CP null danger; any danger in absorptive_parts_zero, flat_danger_count > 0, or a two-sided LFU fit is amber: these challenge the mechanism, not the original sign predictions; original red conditions retain priority
decision_rules.red: directional_stouffer_z < 0, sign_hit_rate < 0.50, a coherent CP asymmetry appears, or the best EFT fit no longer prefers negative Re(C9)

changelog: Adds S7-S9 absorptive nulls, lepton universality, and q2/helicity C9 flatness. v0.1 primary predictions and C9 fit prediction unchanged; v0.2 adds discriminators between a universal real shift and hadronic/LFU-violating alternatives.

flatness_predictions.rationale: A universal shift is constant in q2 and across helicities; q2- or helicity-dependence favours uncalculated long-distance effects; registered against existing data; forward component = Run 3 bin-by-bin C9. Forward quantity: Run 3 bin-by-bin C9.

analysis_notes: Electron fine-bin predictions are retained for future data; two additional 1.1-6.0 predictions score Table 3 of arXiv:2502.10291 exactly once per observable. No artificial fine-bin measurements are inferred.

C9 flatness uses the explicit older numerical Tables 3.3-3.4 of arXiv:2401.18007v2 cited alongside the 2026 update in review Fig. 17. arXiv:2607.09458 displays individual-bin results in Figs. 5.1-5.2 rather than a numerical table; these newer points are not transcribed.

Null chi2 uses diagonal errors and includes the overlapping 1.1-6.0 S7-S9 rows as requested; this is a diagnostic, not an independence-calibrated joint significance. Per-bin warnings must all be reported.
Flatness uses symmetrized marginal errors and treats groups as independent; published correlations and asymmetric likelihood shapes are not available in this CSV schema.
The S7-S9 SM null is an operational discriminator, not a claim that a real short-distance C9 change cannot modify interference with existing SM strong phases.
The global-fit LFU row is a Gaussian approximation to a 68% HPDI, with sign reversed using Eq. 33 of arXiv:2607.03531; it is not an author-supplied Gaussian best fit.

The 2026 long-distance-constrained delta_Re_C9 row is the sign-reversed published extraction in Eq. 5.3 of arXiv:2607.09458, -0.52 +/- 0.25, including its stated theory errors. It is an alternative treatment of the same data, not an independent fit replicate.

baseline_ld and baseline_ld_err are reserved for numerical dispersive postdictions. Section 5.3 and Fig. 5.4 of arXiv:2607.09458 supply figure-only bands; absent author numbers these fields are empty and the LD comparison is unscored. The flavio SM baseline remains unchanged.
